title: Correlation Matrix Heatmap Best Practices
description: Design standards for pairwise correlation heatmaps to maximize clarity and eliminate redundancy.
conditions: Displaying pairwise correlation matrix across 5 to 30 continuous features
recommended_methods: Diverging colormap centered at zero (e.g., Coolwarm, vlag, RdBu) with fixed bounds [-1, +1]
Lower-triangle masking to eliminate redundant symmetric duplicates and identity diagonal
Hierarchical clustering reordering (clustermap) to group correlated features together
selection_rules: Always mask the upper triangle and diagonal (1.00 values) to reduce visual clutter by 55%
Always enforce color scale limits strictly from -1.0 to +1.0 with 0.0 as neutral white/gray
Annotate cell correlation values with 2 decimal places if number of features <= 15
limitations: Heatmaps fail to display non-linear relationships or data distributions underlying the correlation
Heatmaps with > 30 features become unreadable without interactive zooming
